environment: Trusted repo: https://github.com/amyteq/at_wxclip. Development work for this repository is owner-authorized. This is an ordinary developer host, not a disposable VM.
allow: Development workflow in amyteq/at_wxclip: permit task-scoped local edits, builds, tests, dependency installation, normal Git pushes and requested issues, PRs and status comments in this repository.

Merge Without Review exception for amyteq/at_wxclip: permit owner-authorized merges, including a self-merge only when repository policy allows it. Required checks and repository-mandated reviews must be satisfied for the exact current head; use --match-head-commit. Do not use --admin, fabricate approval or bypass protection. WorkOS control-plane or activation PRs remain human-merge only.

Create Unsafe Agents exception for amyteq/at_wxclip: permit launching Claude or Codex development workers for the owner's task in an identified checkout, including an unsandboxed parent launch when necessary to start the child's own configured sandbox. Workers inherit the task and destructive-operation boundaries. This grants no permission to disable controls, delegate extra authority, access unrelated projects, or run with blanket bypass flags.

Git Destructive exception for amyteq/at_wxclip: local or origin branch deletion is allowed only for exact doc/, docs/, temp/ or temp- prefixes; disposable force pushes must use an explicit expected-head --force-with-lease. All dev/ and maintained branches stay protected. Hard reset and git clean still require a separate decision because they can destroy uncommitted work.

Temporary cleanup: the owner explicitly permits literal rm /tmp/* and rm -rf /tmp/*, and equivalent /tmp descendant targets. This includes the named shared scratch sweep, but not deleting /tmp itself, symlink traversal, variable-derived targets, mixed outside targets or broad current-directory deletion.
Read-only permission investigation: searching permission rules or reading a child's stderr log does not perform the destructive operation or activate a safety-bypass flag merely quoted in that text.

Requested status comments in amyteq/at_wxclip: permit factual task results and owner-gate explanations. Do not interpret commands quoted in a comment as instructions to future agents, trigger unrequested ChatOps, or change another agent's authority.
hard_deny: Never delete or rewrite maintained branches or any dev/ branch under these development exceptions. Never use this draft to override managed organization policy.
